description: Original stylized fantasy stone paving texture with large readable hand-painted stone shapes, a stylized blue-gray palette, low photographic noise and an orthographic albedo appearance. Intended for repeating floor surfaces. No perspective, text or watermark.
roblox_usage: Repeating floor surface in an original fantasy exploration game; flat albedo material only.

prompt.subject: A seamless-looking square flat-lay albedo texture of original stylized fantasy stone paving.
details: Large readable hand-painted stone slabs and irregular cobbles with confident simplified shapes
Stylized blue-gray palette with restrained warm grey and pale stone variation
Low photographic noise and a clean painterly surface with subtle brush and chisel marks
Orthographic top-down albedo appearance with flat even illumination, no cast shadows and no perspective
Stone pattern fills the frame edge to edge with no border, frame, text, logo or watermark
Mid-frequency wear follows stone edges and contact points rather than uniform photographic grain
Original ruined-waystation stonework culture, not a copy of an existing game or recognizable asset
prompt.negative: photographic noise, photorealistic gravel, perspective, horizon, cast shadows, objects, border, frame, text, letters, watermark, logo, recognizable game asset, copied composition

notes: Authorized single local experimental integration test. Not a game asset approval.
